Subject: SOC 2 report: portal shows expired - can you send newest?

Hi Jonas,

Quick one — our vendor portal is flagging Redwood as having an expired SOC 2 Type II. The file we have on record is labeled 'Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2023.pdf' with an audit period ending 2024-04-30. We need the most recent attestation (or a bridge letter) to complete our quarterly vendor re-cert.

Can you share the current SOC 2 Type II (PDF) or a bridge letter explaining coverage for 2025-2026? Also any notarized reissue documents would be helpful. Our compliance review is due by 2026-03-05.

Thanks — appreciate a fast turn here.

Best,

Acme Cloud

Hi Maya —

Thanks for flagging this and sorry for the confusion. We recently completed our Type II engagement; the most recent PDF is attached here as 'Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2024-04-30-report.pdf' which covers the period May 1, 2023 — Apr 30, 2024. I realize the filename and audit period don’t reflect calendar-year 2025 coverage — that’s the source of the mismatch.

Short answers:
- We do not have a full re-audit covering May 2024–Apr 2025 yet.
- We can provide a bridge letter that explains the controls posture and any compensating controls for the gap period.
- If you require continuous audit coverage, we can also share our planned re-audit date and an estimated acceptance window.

Looping in Neha (Security) and Grace (Legal) to confirm the bridge letter wording and to route any notarized/reissued documents if needed.

I’m attaching the report we have and a draft bridge; Neha/Grace — can you confirm this draft meets Acme’s requirements or if you want different language for scope/dates?

Next steps: if you confirm the bridge letter format is acceptable, we’ll finalize and send a signed PDF (and push the link to your vendor portal).

Best,

Jonas —

Thanks for the quick reply and for the attachments. A couple clarifying Qs for our vendor intake:

1) The portal flags "Report period ended 2024-04-30" — our policy requires either a report with an audit period ending within the last 12 months or a bridge letter that explicitly covers the gap to our current review date (2026-03-05). Will your bridge cover May 1, 2024 — Mar 31, 2026?

2) Does Redwood plan to re-audit / reissue a Type II report for FY25? If so, when should we expect the new report to be available so we can mark the vendor for re-cert follow-up instead of immediate escalation?

If the draft bridge can be confirmed to cover the requested period and include statements about any material changes to control environment, that should be sufficient for our intake team.

Thanks —
Maya

Attachment: intake_policy_v2.pdf (application/pdf stub)

Thanks for the context, Maya. Quick clarifications from our side:

- The attached PDF 'Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2024-04-30-report.pdf' is the full Type II attestation for the period May 1, 2023 — Apr 30, 2024. There was no material control change after April 30, 2024 that would affect the covered categories.

- We performed an internal control review in Q3 2025 but did not undergo a full third-party re-audit for 2025; that is scheduled for Q4 2026 with an expected public report in Q1 2027.

- We have prepared a formal bridge letter that provides continuity language and explicitly covers May 1, 2024 — Mar 31, 2026, and confirms no material changes. I’ve uploaded the signed version to the link below and attached a DocuSign-signed pdf.

Jonas/Grace — the language cites compensating controls and the limited scope of internal updates; Grace, please confirm legal's sign-off on the bridge wording (I added a clause about timeline for re-audit).
